name: not_deadline_paging_upper_bound_k_plus_one
lines: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq α],
k + 1 ≤ Fintype.card α → ∀ (C₀ : Finset α), C₀.card = k → ∃ Alg, IsCompetitiveRatio k C₀ Alg (↑k + 1)

schedC : ℕ → Finset (ULift.{u_1, 0} (Fin 3)) := fun t => if t = 0 then {q0} else if t = 1 then {q1} else {q2}
⊢ ∀ r ∈ reqsB, ∃ t, r.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ r.deadline ∧ r.page ∈ schedB t
⊢ (if t = 0 then {q0} else if t = 1 then {q2} else {q1}).card ≤ 1
⊢ ∃ t, r.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ r.deadline ∧ r.page ∈ schedB t
hr : r = a ∨ r = b ∨ r = c ∨ r = dB
⊢ ∃ t, a.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ a.deadline ∧ a.page ∈ schedB t
⊢ ∃ t, b.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b.deadline ∧ b.page ∈ schedB t
⊢ ∃ t, c.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ c.deadline ∧ c.page ∈ schedB t
⊢ ∃ t, dB.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ dB.deadline ∧ dB.page ∈ schedB t
⊢ ∀ r ∈ reqsC, ∃ t, r.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ r.deadline ∧ r.page ∈ schedC t
⊢ (if t = 0 then {q0} else if t = 1 then {q1} else {q2}).card ≤ 1
⊢ ∃ t, r.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ r.deadline ∧ r.page ∈ schedC t
hr : r = a ∨ r = b ∨ r = c ∨ r = dC
⊢ ∃ t, a.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ a.deadline ∧ a.page ∈ schedC t
⊢ ∃ t, b.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ b.deadline ∧ b.page ∈ schedC t
⊢ ∃ t, c.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ c.deadline ∧ c.page ∈ schedC t
⊢ ∃ t, dC.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ dC.deadline ∧ dC.page ∈ schedC t
hserveB : ∀ r ∈ reqsB, ∃ t, r.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ r.deadline ∧ r.page ∈ Alg reqsB t
hserveC : ∀ r ∈ reqsC, ∃ t, r.arrival ≤ t ∧ t ≤ r.deadline ∧ r.page ∈ Alg reqsC t
⊢ q1 ∈ Alg reqsB 2 ∧ ∀ x ∈ Alg reqsB 2, x = q1

⊢ List.filter (fun r => decide (r.arrival ≤ 1)) reqsB = List.filter (fun r => decide (r.arrival ≤ 1)) reqsC
